spans.s: भौत [bhauta], a. (-ती f.) [भूतानि प्राणिनो$धिकृत्य प्रवृत्तः, तानि देवता वा अस्य अण्]
तः A worshipper of demons and spirits.
One of the five daily Yajñas to be performed by a householder (also called भूतयज्ञ, q. v.); होमो दैवो बलिर्भौतो नृयज्ञो$तिथिपूजनम्
. -तम् A collection of evil spirits. -ती Night. -Comp. -तुल्य, -प्रिय a. imbecile, deranged, like an idiot.
भौतक [bhautaka], a. Possessed by evil spirits.
Belonging to created or living beings; प्रहुतो भौतिको बलिः
Formed of coarse elements, elemental, material; वृक्षाणां नास्ति भौतिकम्
A being, animal (जीव); कालस्य ते किमुत तत्कृतभौतिकानाम्
Anything elemental. -Comp. -मठः a monastery.-विद्या sorcery, witch-craft.
